about: Append-only record of the person-seed fetches of the LLM-entropy generator's family (b) (coding_plan_06 section 5a): per run its counts, requests, licence, capture date and per opaque seed id only kind and birth-era band.  No name, description or Wikidata id of a seed is ever written: the seeds live in the memory of the process that asked about them.
